Description:
Traveling this harsh environment, you spot an unusually ornate stone - it's a monolith, tribute to the sun and the forest. You are passing through a druid's domain, and he or she might just be watching you from the eyes and form of a woodland critter, ready to leap upon you as a mighty wolf, or in the form of an otherworldly creature of the forest. Travelers beware!
Druids are guardians of their domain, be it a lush forest, a barren wasteland, the peak of a mountain, or the depth of the sea. Most druids can transform into various animals, some even able to invent their own fauna and flora to shape their domain, while others forgo nature entirely to focus on studying the old ways of the cosmos.
A druid is a spellcaster heavily attuned to their environment, who can shapeshift into animals, cast nature magic and channel the old powers of the stars themselves.
Quick Note: A druid is a spellcaster heavily attuned to their environment, who can shapeshift into animals, cast nature magic and channel the old powers of the stars themselves.
Weapons: You are Trained in 2 Weapon Categories of choice (e.g. 1-Handed Melee, 2-Handed Ranged, Shields, etc).
Proficiency Requirements: You are Skilled in Nature and have a number of extra non-combat Skills equal to your Intelligence or Spirit, whichever is higher.

~Skilled in Nature~.Effect: Add your Level to all Checks for identifying plants, knowing about nature and the wilds, etc.

Spellcasting.Change: You can change your known Spells and Talents inbetween Adventures.
Spellcasting.Other: All Druid-specific abilities are considered spells (unless stated otherwise).

Mana.Regain: You regain all Mana back inbetween Adventures.

Spellcasting.Recommended Abilities Description: You can provide healing and utility to your team with Healing Surge and Speak With Plants, deal flexible damage and Crowd Control with Poison Burst and Intelligence Blast, and provide buffs to your party with Wild Dexterity.

Druidic: Whistletone is the art of conveying information at long distances through whistles, claps and snaps. Druids specifically can also incorporate magic into their Whistletone to mimick the breeze of the wind, the subtle sound of thunder in the distance, or even replicate smells and miasmas to convey hidden messages.

Starting Abilities Description.Druidcraft:
Druids have the ability to create small magical effects that affect plants, animals or just nature.
You can use the Druidcraft Spell in roleplay scenarios to affect the environment and people.

Starting Abilities Description.Shapeshift:
As a Druid, you can tranform into various animals, both in combat and outside of combat.
The Shapeshift Spell provides an infinite amount of options to help out your party in any situation!
You can choose any animal from the Animals list to Shapeshift into, as long as it's not Exotic or non-standard. Each Animal allows you to use its special Ability once per Adventure. You are still only allowed to use that Ability once per Adventure, even if you Shapeshift into that animal twice (the cooldown stays the same).
Other Druid Talents might allow you to Shapeshift into more unusual beasts.
Shapeshift is considered a Spell.

When in Shapeshift form, you always have access to the Animal Attack Ability, which is not considered a Spell.
Animal Attack is, of course, impaired if you are Crippled.

~Naturality~.Effect:
You start with +1 in any Stat (up to +3) and +2 Skill Points.
You may have 1 additional Utility Talent from any available Level.

~Animal Attack~.EffectGreen: Critical Strike - if you roll maximum, apply a Combo.

~Shapeshift~.Duration: Until cancelled (0 AP) or you Fall
~Shapeshift~.Effect: Transform into a medium-sized, regular animal, or a mystical beast resembling one you've encountered this Campaign. It has 2 features of choice from below (up to your Level).
~Shapeshift~.Notes:
Your animal's Stats are 3/1/0/-1 spread as you like (for Rolls only).
You can only cast _some_ Abilities while Shapeshifted.
You choose what items you keep on you when Shapeshifting, and those items are 'merged' into your new form.
While Shapeshifted, you can speak, but your voice is slightly altered to match your shape (e.g. guttural for lions, high pitched for birds, etc).

SpellTable.Name: Hefty
SpellTable.Effect: When Shapeshifting, gain 3 Shieldings that block 1d4 Damage each. You are Long (2x1 meters) and Ridable.

SpellTable.Name: Clawed
SpellTable.Effect: Your animal features listed here have their Dice Upgraded to the next die type.

SpellTable.Name: Sweep {Action}2 Action Points {Cooldown} Once / Shapeshift
SpellTable.Effect: All Units within 2 meters take 2d4 + Your Highest Stat (any type). If only one Unit is hit, +50% Damage and apply a Combo.

SpellTable.Name: Bash {Action}1 Action Point {Level}Level 2 {Cooldown} Once / Combat
SpellTable.Effect:
Single-Stun a Unit and deal 1d4 Smash Damage to it.
{Combo} and a one Unit 2 meter from you.

SpellTable.Name: Venomous {Level}Level 3
SpellTable.Effect: Animal Attacks deal +1d4 Damage to Units affected by Crowd Control. {Combo} +1d4 Damage.

SpellTable.Name: Fast {Level}Level 4
SpellTable.Effect: You have +3 Movement Speed. You can freely Break Movement.

SpellTable.Name: Sticky {Action}1 Action Point {Range}3 meters {Level}Level 5
SpellTable.Effect: Shoot a sticky substance at a Unit. It takes 1d4 Damage, becomes Rooted and apply a Combo. Usable once per Shapeshift.

SpellTable.Name: Shred {Action}2 Action Points {Level}Level 6
SpellTable.Effect: Attack a Unit for 2d8 + 3 Slash Damage. Deals +1d8 Damage for each level of Stun on it.

SpellTable.Name: Leap {Action}1 Action Point {Level}Level 7
SpellTable.Effect: Leap at a Unit 2-3 meters away. Deal 2d6 Pulse Damage and apply a Combo. {Combo} it becomes Frail.

SpellTable.Name: Fly {Level}Level 8
SpellTable.Effect: You can fly up to your speed. You take -50% Smash Damage.

SpellTable.Name: Large {Level}Level 9
SpellTable.Effect: You have 2 Defense. You are Large (2x2 meters) and Ridable.

~Thornskin~.Effect:
Choose a Unit you can see. Apply a Combo to it.
Whenever it is melee attacked, the attacker takes 1d4 Pierce Damage.
~Thornskin~.Notes: A Unit can only be effected by one Thornskin effect at a time.

~Venin Shot~.Effect:
A target takes 1d8 + ^Soul^ Poison Damage.
The _next time_ it takes damage from a weapon, it takes an extra 1d8 Poison Damage.
~Venin Shot~.Combo: The next time Damage happens now instead.

~Ripstorm~.Effect:
Deal 5d6 Damage to all Worthy Units within 2 meters of you.
Heal for 1 Health per 5 real Damage done (total).
One of the Units hit becomes Crippled.

~Druidcraft~.Effect:
You can create harmless sensory effects, tiny weather effects or soothe mild pains.
You can speed up the growth of small plants by 1000% while channeling.
You can speed up the progress of a disease or illness by 1000% while channeling.

~Control Wind~.Effect:
You can control gusts of wind in a 6x6x6 area and do one of the following for 1 Action:
{Diamond} Create Heavy Wind blowing from any direction (see notes) that lasts for 1 minute
{Diamond} Move Heavy Wind 3 meters in any direction
{Diamond} Create wind that makes Units fall softly
{Diamond} Stop it (for 0 Actions)
{Diamond} Push all Units in the wind 1 meter in the wind's direction
~Control Wind~.Notes:
Moving against Heavy Wind acts as Hard Terrain.
Projectiles fired against the Wind have -1 Damage, and projectiles fired with the Wind gain +1.
Multiple Winds don't stack into eachother.
Heavy Wind also clears Fog, Smoke, etc in the area.

~Fog Cloud~.Effect: A 5x5x5 meter cube becomes covered in fog for 1 minute.
~Fog Cloud~.Upgrade: All Attacks done from, through or to Units inside Fog have Cover (-50%).
~Fog Cloud~.Notes: Fog can be dissipated by wind. You can choose the color of the fog. The fog does not go through walls, but does bend around corners (e.g. up to 360 degrees around wall extremities).

~Wild Steed~.Effect:
You call upon a ridable land animal native to the area you are in.
You and up to 1 more party member can ride this animal.
It follows the normal rules for Riding.
It does not participate in combat.
~Wild Steed~.Upgrade: At Level 6, this can be a flying animal.

Specializations.Description: At Level 2, you can choose your coven (Specialization). A coven is a spiritual path you adhere to, and whose culture you represent.
Choices: Coven of the Land, a protector of the flora and fauna specific to your chosen domain
Coven of the Old Ways, using the old magic, worshipping old gods and drawing power from the sun, the moon and the stars
Coven of the Wild, where your true fey or animalistic nature takes shape!

Coven of the Land.Description: The Druid of the Land is a guardian of its own domain. Be it a lush forest, a snowy mountain or a rocky cave, the Druid of the Land knows its own ways.

~Domain~.Effect:
Choose a _domain environment_ from: {Brown('Nature, Water, Air, Earth')}.
Your Abilities may have extra effects based both on your _domain_ and the current _environment_ (if you're outside).
~Domain~.Upgrade: The Quest Master determines what environment you're in. It's possible to not be in any domain (e.g. urban areas, interiors, etc).
~Domain~.Notes: Nature (Forests, Jungles, etc), Water (Lakes, Swamps, etc), Air (Fields, Mountains, etc) and Earth (Deserts, Caves, etc).

~Regrowth~.Effect:
Your next Ability or animal feature is improved based on your and current _domains_.

{Brown('Nature:')} Dice Upgraded to next die type.
{Brown('Water:')} Heals an ally you can see for 1d8.
{Brown('Wind:')} No Cooldown. You gain +2 Speed this combat.
{Brown('Earth:')} +2 Max Health to you or a target (permanently).

~Wild Heart~.Effect:
Up to 2 allies gain 1d4 Health Regen each.

{Brown('Nature:')} +1 Unit affected.
{Brown('Water:')} 1d6 instead.
~Wild Heart~.Combo: A Comboed target gains +1 Max Health permanently.

~Wind Chaser~.Effect:
Your next targeted attack or Spell curves around obstacles, ignoring Cover and dealing +1d4 Damage.

{Brown('Wind:')} +1d6 Damage instead.
{Brown('Earth:')} And Slows it.
~Wind Chaser~.Notes: You still need Line of Sight to the target.

~Earth Shield~.Effect:
A Unit you can see gains 2 Shieldings that block 1d4 Damage each.

{Brown('Earth:')} 1d6 instead.
{Brown('Nature:')} 3 Shieldings instead.
~Earth Shield~.Notes: Lasts for 24 hours or until you rolled the d4 3 times. Does not stack multiple times with itself.

~Nami~.Effect:
Send out a 4x1 meter wave forward. Each Unit* hit takes 2d8 Cold Damage and is Slowed.

{Brown('Water:')} Allies hit are Healed for 1d6 instead.
{Brown('Wind:')} 6x2 meter wave instead.
~Nami~.Notes: If in a Water environment/domain, Allies are Healed and Enemies are Damaged. Otherwise, all Units hit are Damaged.

~Domain Animal Attack~.Effect:
{Brown('Nature:')} ~Heal for 10% of the attack's Damage.~
{Brown('Water:')} ~Target is Slowed and +1 range.~
{Brown('Wind:')} ~1d8 Damage instead of 1d6.~
{Brown('Earth:')} ~Taunt the target.~
~Domain Animal Attack~.EffectGreen: Critical Strike - if you roll maximum, apply a Combo.

<Innervate>.Effect: Heal another ally for 1d12 Health and it regains 1 Mana or provides 1 more use of an Ability that is on Cooldown.
<Innervate>.Downside: Can not be cast on Druids.

~Nativity~.Effect: Every ~real hour~, regain up to {Mana}0.5 Mana.

~Cutting Winds~.Effect:
A Unit takes 2d6 + ^Your Dexterity^ Slash Damage.

{Brown('Wind:')} Push it 3 meters (any direction).
{Brown('Water:')} +1d6 Damage

~Roots~.Effect:
All Enemies within 4 meters of you take 2d6 Pierce Damage and become Rooted.

{Brown('Nature:')} 6 meters instead.
{Brown('Earth:')} 2d8 Damage instead.

~Lightning Storm~.Effect:
Choose a 4x4x4 meter cube.
All units inside take 3d4 Shock Damage now. If a unit carries anything made of metal or is wet, it takes 100% more Damage.

{Brown('Wind:')} 4d4 Damage instead.
{Brown('Nature:')} The Damage triggers again at the start of your next Turn in the same area.

<Brineborne Lullaby>.Effect:
Choose yourself.
Heal the chosen Unit for 1d8 for each 10 Health it is missing, and all Units within 2 meters of it for half the final amount just Healed.

{Brown('Water:')} For each 7 Health missing instead.
{Brown('Earth:')} Choose any Unit instead.

~Runeback Form~.Effect:
Your animal forms become improved by visible tattoos, runes or trinkets adorning your horns, paws or back.
Depending on your and current _domain_, you gain additional powers when Shapeshifted.

{Brown('Earth:')} You take -1 Damage from all sources.
{Brown('Nature:')} Every Turn end, Heal yourself for 1d4.
{Brown('Water:')} You do +1 Damage and Healing.
{Brown('Wind:')} You can cast any Spell while Shapeshifted, and any animal feature while not.

~Celestine Regrowth~.Effect:
Your next Ability or animal feature is improved based on your and current _domains_.

{Brown('Nature:')} Dice Upgraded to next die type.
{Brown('Water:')} Heals an ally you can see for 1d8.
{Brown('Wind:')} No Cooldown. You gain +2 Speed this combat.
{Brown('Earth:')} +2 Max Health to you or a target (permanently).

<Dazzling Miasma>.Effect:
Shoot a tainted gust of spores in a 10x1 meter line from your position.
It hits the first 2 Units it travels into.
If you hit one Unit, it takes 7d6 Poison Damage.
If you hit 2 Units, each takes 2d10 Poison Damage and is Blinded.

~Water Breathing~.Effect: Up to 2 allies you can see (can include yourself) can now breathe under water.

~Tree Stride~.Effect:
While within 30 meters of trees, you have +1 Movement Speed.
You can climb trees without making Rolls, using your normal Movement.
You can use as many meters of your Movement as you like to jump that distance from one tree to another.

<Moonwing Lullaby>.Effect:
Choose a Unit.
Now and at the start of your next turn, heal it for 1d10 for each 10 Health it is missing.

<Wicked Animals>.Effect:
Call upon 2 animals, both of which are specific to your _domain_, but have Max Health as if they were 4 Levels lower than you.
They appear on the edge of the battlefield, from the wilderness, and they fight for you for up to 1 minute.
<Wicked Animals>.Notes: Both animals must be of the same type. This is considered a Spell.

Manual Extras: +1 in a Stat of choice (up to +5)
<Stat Bonus 5>.Effect: Gain +1 in a Stat of choice, up to +5.

<Land Bonus>.Effect: Gain one more Level 3 Talent or one more Domain.

<Landscaping>.Effect:
An area 1d8 kilometers in diameter centered on you changes to match your _domain_, and, when casting this, you can shape the earth, plants, sky, etc within 100 meters to your liking.
Also, passively, while in your _domain_, you have all your ^Dice Upgraded^ to the next die type (and d12's become d20's), and You automatically pass all Hard Spirit Checks (that require at least 15).

<Embrace Gaia>.Effect:
You gain the effects of all (4) Domain Abilities.
While in your primary _domain_, Nature Spells cost no Mana.
You are immune to normal diseases and ailments, and you can not die from old age, but your body continues to age indefinitely.

Coven of the Wild.Description: You are heavily in touch with nature and with strange creatures, uncommon to the normal folk.

~Wild Shapeshift~.Duration: Until cancelled (0 AP) or you Fall
~Wild Shapeshift~.Effect:
Transform into a medium-sized, regular animal, or a mystical beast resembling one you've encountered this Campaign. It has ~3~ features of choice from below (up to your Level).
~Many of the features are available earlier or upgraded.~
~You can cast any Druid Ability while Shapeshifted.~
~Wild Shapeshift~.Notes:
Your animal's Stats are 3/1/0/-1 spread as you like (for Rolls only).
You can only cast _some_ Abilities while Shapeshifted.
You choose what items you keep on you when Shapeshifting, and those items are 'merged' into your new form.
While Shapeshifted, you can speak, but your voice is slightly altered to match your shape (e.g. guttural for lions, high pitched for birds, etc).

SpellTable.Name: Hefty
SpellTable.Effect: When Shapeshifting, gain 3 Shieldings that block 1d4 Damage each. You are Long (2x1 meters) and Ridable.

SpellTable.Name: Clawed
SpellTable.Effect: Your ~Abilities that say 'Usable/Only usable while Shapeshifted', Animal Attack and~ animal features here have their Dice Upgraded to the next die type.

SpellTable.Name: Sweep {Action}2 Action Points {Cooldown} Once / Shapeshift
SpellTable.Effect: All Units within 2 meters take ~2d4 + Your Level Damage (any type)~. If only one Unit is hit, +50% Damage and apply a Combo.

SpellTable.Name: Bash {Action}1 Action Point {Level}Level 2 {Cooldown} Once / Combat
SpellTable.Effect:
Single-Stun a Unit and deal 1d4 Smash Damage to it.
{Combo} and a one Unit 2 meter from you.

SpellTable.Name: Venomous {Level}Level 3
SpellTable.Effect: Animal Attacks deal +1d4 Damage to Units affected by Crowd Control. {Combo} +1d4 Damage.

SpellTable.Name: Fast and Tiny {Level}Level 4
SpellTable.Effect: You have +3 Movement Speed. You can freely Break Movement. ~Optionally, your size can be Tiny.~

SpellTable.Name: Sticky {Action}1 Action Point {Range}3 meters {Level}Level 4
SpellTable.Effect: Shoot a sticky substance at a Unit. It takes 1d4 Damage, becomes Rooted and apply a Combo. Usable once per Shapeshift.

SpellTable.Name: Shred {Action}2 Action Points {Level}Level 5
SpellTable.Effect: Attack a Unit for 2d8 + ~Any of your Stats (not the animal's)~ Slash Damage. Deals +1d8 Damage for each level of Stun on it.

SpellTable.Name: Leap {Action}1 Action Point {Level}Level 6
SpellTable.Effect: Leap at a Unit ~2-4~ meters away. Deal 2d6 Pulse Damage and apply a Combo. {Combo} it becomes Frail.

SpellTable.Name: Fly {Level}Level 7
SpellTable.Effect: You can fly up to your speed. You take -50% Smash Damage.

SpellTable.Name: Large {Level}Level 8
SpellTable.Effect: You have 2 Defense. You are Large (2x2 meters) ~or larger (3x3 meters)~ and Ridable.

SpellTable.Name: Charge {Level}Level 9
SpellTable.Effect:
After Shapeshifting, your next Attack deals +2 Damage per meter just moved (*).
{Combo} And Slams target 3 meters (any direction).

~Recuperate~.Effect: Heal yourself for 1d10. If you're affected by any Crowd Control, remove them instead of Healing.

~Blightborne Wither~.Effect: Attack a Unit for 3d4 Poison Damage. Its Passives, weapon* effects and Reactions are disabled until your next Turn.
~Blightborne Wither~.Notes: Its Passives become disabled before you hit it (e.g. Kobolds don't dodge this attack). Some monsters have special weapon* effects, like Centaurs who gain extra Damage based on how much they moved. These are disabled.

~Web~.Effect:
Declare a 4x4 meter area. All Units there become Rooted or Single-Stunned (their choice).
The area becomes filled with spider web and counts as Hard Terrain.
If inside, your next Move Action has doubled speed.

~Fenfever~.Effect: Your next Ability of animal feature has its ^Dice Upgraded^ to the next die type.

~Elderform~.Effect: You have extra available features originating from the flora and microbiomes of the outdoors.

SpellTable.Name: Spikes
SpellTable.Effect: After you are attacked from 1 meter away, deal 1d4 Damage back to the attacker. You take -50% Pierce Damage.

SpellTable.Name: Photosynthesis
SpellTable.Effect: You regenerate 1d4 Health at the end of every Turn.

SpellTable.Name: Blossoming {Cooldown} Once / Adventure
SpellTable.Effect: At the end of the Adventure, the Quest Master gives you an additional positive Quirk.

~Drakeform~.Effect: You gain extra animal features based on dragons.

SpellTable.Name: Manathirst {Requirement} Only usable in Worthy Combat {Cooldown} Once / Adventure
SpellTable.Effect: When Shapeshifting, refresh 1 Mana.

SpellTable.Name: Elemental Breath {Range} 5 meters
SpellTable.Effect: When Shapeshifting, choose any Element. Your Animal Attack is ranged, its Damage Type is of the chosen Element and 50% of the dealt Damage is splashed to all Units within 2 meters of the main target.

SpellTable.Name: Elemental Scales
SpellTable.Effect: When Shapeshifting, choose any Element. You take -50% Damage Type of that Element.

~Primalform~.Effect: You gain extra animal features originating from wild creatures of the faey.

SpellTable.Name: Prowling
SpellTable.Effect: First Shapeshifted attack deals +1d8 Damage. If starting combat shapeshifted, YOU Surprise enemies and can't be Surprised.

SpellTable.Name: Horned
SpellTable.Effect: First Shapeshifted attack deals +1d4 Damage and Slams the target 1d4 meters in any direction.

SpellTable.Name: Hulking
SpellTable.Effect: When Shapeshifting, permanently increase your current and Max Health by 1.

~Wildcasting Form~.Effect:
When you Shapeshift, transform into a combination of 4 ^random^ animal features instead of choosing, ignoring the Level requirements.
Roll 4d12 and reroll any duplicates to determine your form.

~FURY~.Upgrade: Every time you do Healing or weapon Damage, do +1 for each {Orange('Fury')}, then lose 1 {Orange('Fury')}.

~Fruit of the Forest~.Effect: Find, conjure or enchant 3 bites of food. Each bite restores 1d6 Health when eaten (with 1 Action Point).

<Shapeshift Ally>.Effect:
Passively, increase your Max Mana by 1.
Instead of Shapeshifting yourself, you can choose an ally and Shapeshift them into an animal with 3 features of your choice from your available features.
They have Animal Attack Ability. They can cancel it for 0 Actions on their turn.

<Evershape>.Effect: Shapeshifting yourself doesn't cost Mana, but it has a Once / Combat Cooldown.

~Manshape~.Effect:
Choose a Unit you can see that you've talked to and fought with.
You transform into a copy of them, with their equipment, Stats, non-combat Skills and Abilities.
~Manshape~.Upgrade: Your Max Health and Mana stay the same and you still have access to all your Abilities and non-combat Skills.
~Manshape~.EffectRed: You can't use their Abilities that have a Cooldown longer than Once / Combat or Once / real hour.
~Manshape~.Notes: Your copy of their equipment is not unequippable and vanishes immediately if dropped or unquipped.

~Strangevolution~.Effect: Permanently gain 4 Race Talents, from any Race(s) except Orcs.

~Camouflage~.Effect:
You and all your pets (if any) become camouflaged and turn effectively invisible and causing no sound, undetectable by the naked eye.
While camouflaged, your Movement is halved.
You appear, however, in mirrors, reflections and in recordings (as well as your sounds).

~Breathing Technique~.Effect: You can breathe underwater for up to 1d20 minutes and swim at your normal speed.

~Wilder Shape~.Effect: You Shapeshift with 1 additional animal feature.
~Wilder Shape~.Upgrade: In addition, you're free to just choose one animal at first when you use Shapeshift, then freely add animals to the combination if you need their Abilities. Build-a-werebeast, step by step!

<Evershape>.Effect: When Shapeshifting yourself, it doesn't cost Mana.
<Evershape>.Notes: This means that unless you use Shapeshift Ally, you can Shapeshift as much as you like. Note that the Cooldowns of Animal Abilities persist and don't reset.

<Werebeast Blood>.Effect: You can Shapeshift into a combination of 3 animals. You gain 7 Max Health.
<Werebeast Blood>.Upgrade: In addition, you're free to just choose one animal at first when you use Shapeshift, then freely add animals to the combination if you need their Abilities. Build-a-werebeast, step by step!

<Beastly Stamina>.Effect: For each animal, you gain an extra use of their Abilities that have a Cooldown of Once / Combat or Once / Adventure.

<Ultimate Shapeshift>.Effect:
Once per Adventure, you can transform into a Beast, Fey, Monster, Plant or Dragon you have previously interacted with that is worth at most 1000 XP using Wild Shape.
If it's an Epic Monster, you can use that many of its Abilities on your turn instead of doing your regular Action.
Also, passively, your Might and Intelligence increase by 1.

<Apex Predator>.Effect:
Your Animal Abilities have no Cooldown, their Stats are tripled, and you have an extra Half-Action per Turn while Shapeshifted.
You automatically pass all Very Hard Spirit Checks (that require at least 20).

<Strong-Soul Shapeshift>.Duration: Lasts up to until Shapeshift ends
<Strong-Soul Shapeshift>.Effect:
When Shapeshifting, you gain Shielding equal to the Health of one of the animals.
When all your Shielding is destroyed, you revert back to your person form.
Also, passively, your Dexterity and Spirit increase by 1.

Coven of the Old Ways.Description:
You worship the sun, the moon and the stars, for only they can truly guide your path.
Pagan Druids believe no one has the right to dictate someone else's spiritual path.
As a Pagan Druid, you oppose fanaticism, opressors and stupidity.
Pagan Druids usually worship no god, but they do acknowledge their power and they heavily respect nature and the earth.
A Pagan Druid gains the power through not black, nor white magic.
The suggested alignment for Pagan Druids is True Neutral.

~Day Night Cycle~.Effect:
You are always in either {Orange('Solar')} or {Purple('Lunar')} stance, based on the _period of day_ (see gray text).

{Orange('Solar Stance')}: you have +3 Health Regen and can cast any Ability Shapeshifted.

{Purple('Lunar Stance')}: once per attack/Ability/animal feature, when you roll maximum on a die, roll one more.
~Day Night Cycle~.Notes:
{Orange('Solar Stance')} period is from 6:00 to 18:00. {Purple('Lunar Stance')} period is from 18:00 to 6:00.
Your stance may change during combat. {Orange('Solar Stance')} Health Regen applies if you end the combat in Solar Stance.
If the campaign setting somehow skewes the day/night cycle, the Quest Master should find a different criterion to determine day/night.

~Moonsun Fire~.Effect:
{Orange('Solar Stance')}: Damage an enemy for 1d4 + ^Any Stat^ (Fire), then Heal an ally for the same amount.

{Purple('Lunar Stance')}: Damage or Heal a Unit for 1d4 + ^Any Stat^ (Pulse) and apply a ~Combo~. The next ~Combo~ on that Unit triggers twice!

~Burnished Flames~.Effect: Deal 1d12 + ^Spirit^ Damage (Fire if {Orange('Solar')}, Scourge if {Purple('Lunar')}) and apply a Combo.

~Curse of Locusts~.Effect:
A swarm of locusts appears and chases a Unit you can see for 1 minute.

{Orange('Solar Stance')}: Whenever it makes a Move Act, it takes 1d4 Poison Damage.

{Purple('Lunar Stance')}: For every Act not spent Moving, it takes 1d4 Acid Damage

~Effigy of Warding~.Cooldown: Up to 1 effigy placed at a time
~Effigy of Warding~.Effect:
Place an effigy in a space. It triggers an effect when a Unit comes within 2 meters of it:
If Enemy, it takes +50% Damage next time it takes Damage.
If Ally, it takes -50% Damage next time it takes Damage.
~Effigy of Warding~.Upgrade: Does not trigger if the Unit was already there.

~Solunar Psyche Blast~.Effect:
A Unit takes 3d6 Psychic Damage and:

{Orange('Solar Stance')}: it becomes Blinded or Silenced (your choice).

{Purple('Lunar Stance')}: An ally within 3 meters is healed for 50% of the Damage dealt.

~Improved Moonsun Fire~.Effect:
{Orange('Solar Stance')}: Damage ~and Root~ an enemy for 1d4 + ^Any Stat^ (Fire), then Heal an ally for the same amount.

{Purple('Lunar Stance')}: Damage ~and Single-Stun~ or Heal a Unit for ~2d4~ + ^Any Stat^ (Pulse) and apply a ~Combo~. The next ~Combo~ on that Unit triggers twice!

<Daybreak-Nightfall>.Effect: When you pass from day to night and viceversa, roll 1d4 and gain one of these boons.
SingleTable: 3. Your next Spell costs -1 Action Point

<Forced Eclipse>.Effect:
By weather-wight and star-song, I bid the sun forth and call the moon to reign!
Force 1 minute of artificial day or night in a 1km area around you.
<Forced Eclipse>.Upgrade: This can reset the Cooldown of Moonsun Fire's, once when it happens, and again when it ends.
<Forced Eclipse>.Notes: Nothing happens if used with Equinox.

~Love and Lust~.Effect:
At the end of the Adventure, if most of your time was spent in a certain stance this Adventure, gain a permanent bonus:

{Orange('Solar Stance')}: Gain +2 Skill Points.

{Purple('Lunar Stance')}: Gain an extra positive Quirk.
~Love and Lust~.Upgrade: These effects are permanent, even after you no longer have this Talent.

<Star Fall>.Effect:
{Orange('Solar Stance')}: Heal a Unit for 6d12.

{Purple('Lunar Stance')}: Damage a Unit for 6d10 True Damage.

~Eclipsis Penumbrae~.Effect: For 1 hour, you are both in {Orange('Solar Stance')} and {Purple('Lunar Stance')}. Both effects apply.

~Zodiac Alignment~.Effect:
Declare a 4x4 meter area.

{Orange('Solar Stance')}: Deal Fire Damage to all Units caught equal to the number of empty spaces in the area.

{Purple('Lunar Stance')}: Declare 1 animal feature. Shapeshift all Units caught into an animal with that feature for their next Turn.
~Zodiac Alignment~.Notes: The Damage is dealt all at once, not 1 by 1. Shapeshifted Units can not do their regular Abilities and can't cancel the effect. They remain Shapeshifted until the end of their (next) Turn.

~Consummation~.Effect:
{Orange('Solar Stance')}: Eat a non-Epic, Large or smaller Unit. While inside you, they are Blinded and Rooted to you and can only target you. {Color('red' 'Only usable while Shapeshifted')}.

{Purple('Lunar Stance')}: You and a chosen Unit are bound in exile, banished together into the Celestial Veil until the end of their (next) Turn. It is Single-Stunned and Slowed. Your Turn ends immediately after casting this Spell.

You can only target each Unit Once / Combat.
~Consummation~.Notes: Whilst beneath the Celestial Veil, no hand nor spell may pass between banished ones and the waking world. Yet to mortal sight, those who walk the Celestial Realm are glimpsed faintly, as wraith-shadows drifting at the edge of vision.

~Primal Form~.Effect:
Your animal forms become improved and more akin to feral or primal animals, with larger fur, longer claws, thicker horns or even glowing eyes, depending on your stance.

{Orange('Solar Stance')}: You can pick one additional animal feature when Shapeshifting.

{Purple('Lunar Stance')}: You deal +1 Damage (from all source) and have +1 Movement Speed while Shapeshifted.

~Blessing of Yune~.Effect:
You weave a Blessing of Yune upon a willing ally whose spirit is clean and mind at ease, binding their soul to the turning of the sun and moon forever, while you have this Talent.

That ally now has the Day Night Cycle Ability, permanently.
~Blessing of Yune~.Notes: Once blessed, they are bound by celestial worship until death. Should they be reborn anew, you may bestow the blessing upon someone else.

<Sunrise/Moonfall>.Effect: Moonsun Fire now hits one extra target, deals 1d4 extra Damage and ignores Defense and Resistances.

<Equinox>.Effect: Your next Spell (this Turn or next) casts twice.
<Equinox>.Upgrade: If you use this with Shapeshift, you can combine into 2 animals, and have both their Abilities and their highest Stats.
<Equinox>.Notes: On the second cast, you can choose different targets, areas, etc (and it ignores Cooldown, Costs, etc).

~Portal~.Effect:
Start conjuring a portal at your location resembling the nature of your specialization and studies.
Think of an exact destination within 1000km.
At the end of the cast time, a portal opens at this location and the destination.
~Portal~.Notes:
At the end of the spell, the destination must be empty for the portal to appear there. Otherwise the portal spell is cancelled and goes on a 1 real hour Cooldown.
Stepping through one of the portals (obviously) teleports the Unit to the other portal.

~Barkskin~.Effect:
An ally you can see (or yourself) becomes Rooted in the ground.
While rooted, that Unit's Defense can't be lower than 5.
Lasts until that Unit moves from place.

<Shapeshift Fire>.Effect: Whenever you Shapeshift into an animal specific to the current time of day, cast Moonsun Fire for free, ignoring its Cooldown.
<Shapeshift Fire>.Notes: The chosen animal must be approved by the QM to trigger the free Moonsun Fire.

~Stunning~.Effect: Solar or Lunar - max die = heal or CC

<Pet Attack>.Effect:
The pet melee attacks a target.
The attack deals 1d6 Pierce of Slash Damage (your choice).

~Full Moon~.Effect: At the start of every Combat, if twilight, you have a 1/6 chance to be a full moon.

~Animal Feature~.Effect: You have any animal feature while not shapeshifted.

<Soulfire>.Effect:
Moonsun Fire has no Cooldown.
You become immune to Fire and Scourge Damage, and to being Blinded and Feared.
Passively, you always know the locations of any living Units within 15 meters, and you gain +2 Spirit.

<Be It Dawn or Dusk>.Effect:
When it breaks _day_, you heal for 50% of your Max Health.
When it breaks _twilight_, you recover 50% of your Max Mana.
Gain +1 Spirit and Intelligence.
